quote: Automatic evaluation metrics. We evaluate the quality of generated impressions with ROUGE F1 to measure unigram and bigram overlap as a proxy for relevance (R-1, R-2) and the longest common subsequence as a proxy for fluency (R-L). In addition, we report BERTScore as a measure of soft-alignment. As factual correctness is critical, we also calculate a factuality F1.
